**How to submit:** Write your answers in a document or on paper. Upload the file or a clear photo to the university e-learning platform. Due: **one week after lecture 12**.
No task needs AI.

A small studio will **sell** *Lantern Lane*, a calm game about a girl who
lights lamps in an old town. These are five of its assets:

| asset | made by | licence or contract |
|---|---|---|
| the girl (sprite) | an artist employed by the studio | employment contract |
| a wind sound | a sound artist on a sound website | CC BY |
| the title music | a freelance composer, paid | no written contract |
| a photo of an old door | found with an image search | unknown |
| an old folk song | composer died in 1890; recorded by the studio | none |

## Task 1 · The rights check (3 marks)

a) For each asset, write who owns it. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=5 >}}

b) For each asset, write "use it", "use it with a credit", or the fix
(ask, replace or remove). (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=5 >}}

c) Write a correct credit line for the wind sound (invent the name of the
sound artist and the title). (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · Two problems (2 marks)

a) A team member wants to use a cat drawing under **CC BY-NC** for the
store page. May the studio use it? Explain in one sentence. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) Another team member says: "Our logo is only 30 % different from the logo
of a famous coffee brand, so it is fine." Is this right? What do you
advise? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}
